question: Who among the following took oath as Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir in August 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manoj Sinha__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Manoj Sinha is an Indian politician and is the current Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir.

 
 
• He served as the Minister of State for Railways and Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Communications in the Government of India.
